responsibility: This header defines GCC’s generic fixed-size object pool allocator templates. It provides the base_pool_allocator and object_allocator abstractions that manage block-backed free lists for uniformly-sized objects, including optional checking IDs, valgrind annotations, release/reuse logic, and memory-accounting descriptors; clients use it to allocate and recycle compiler data structures efficiently while sharing stable APIs for statistics and pool lifetime management.
same_name_distinction: Defines the alloc-pool API and implementation templates (base_pool_allocator, object_allocator, pool_usage, inline allocate/remove/release logic), while gcc/alloc-pool.cc is limited to the shared globals and the statistics-dumping function those templates use.
